# authwise_audience (Data Source)

An API an issuer mints access tokens for, and the audience its Access catalog hangs off. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `appearance_profile_id` (String)
- `audience_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `issuer_id` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
